verses.text: Ay wal ek' wach' lolonel t'a in pensar. Ol in b'itan t'a winh rey yet' juntzanh in lolonel chi'. Ha in ti' lajan icha stz'ib'lab' junok mach te jelan stz'ib'ani.
Ach rey, a achnhej wach' ilji t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh winak. Te wach'nhej tas tzala', te jelan a loloni yujto syak'nhej swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh.
Ak'och jachan k'e'en espada t'a a nanhal, ach winak te ak'um owal, te b'inajnak ach, te ay wal elk'ochi.
Ixik t'a yib'anh nok' a chej yet' a poder yik tzak'an ganar owal, yik sb'oji yaj lolonel t'a stojolal t'a heb' emnakil. Niwan tastak satub'tak ol a k'ulej yet' ipalil.
Ach ko reyal, a jul-lab' te jay snhi' ol b'at ch'apnaj t'a snhi' sk'o'ol heb' ajk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ol telwok heb' anima yik juntzanh chonhab' t'a skal ok.
Ach ko Diosal, yajal ach t'a smasanil tiempo. Yajal ach, wach'nhej tz'aj a ch'olb'itan tastak.
Ha wal tojolal scha a k'o'ol, max schalaj a k'o'ol chukal. Yuj chi' ix ach sik'el Dios, haton a Diosal. Ix yak' niwan tzalajk'olal t'ayach t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio het'ok.
Tz'el sjab' sperfume'al mirra, áloes yet' te' canela ayoch t'a a pichul. Ha son ay sch'anhal ol ak'an tzalaj a k'o'ol t'a a pat marfilnhej ayoch yelwanub'ok.
Ay heb' ix yisil heb' winh rey t'a skal heb' awtab'il u'uj. Ha t'a a tz'ey t'a a wach', hata' ayek' ix reina. Ha k'e'en oro yelxo wal wach' ayoch t'a spichul ix.
Ach yisil rey, maklej wal ab'i, scham wal ab'an tas ol wal t'ayach. Manhxo a na heb' a k'ab' ok yet' heb' etchonhab',
yujto a winh rey chi' snib'an swach'il ilji, haton winh ajalil. Hak'em a b'a t'a winh.
Ol yak' silab' heb' aj Tiro t'ayach. Ha heb' niwak b'eyum, ol snib'ej heb' yoch amigo'ok.
Tik sja ix ix wan yoch yetb'eyumok winh rey, wach'nhej yilji ix, yisil pax ix junokxo winh rey. Oro ayoch yelwanub'ok spichul ix.
Wach'nhej yaj sb'o ix yet' spichul, tz'ik'jib'at ix t'a winh rey. Tzak'anoch heb' ix kob'estak yuk'lewok ix, haton heb' ix yamiga ix.
Stzalaj heb' ix sb'at heb' ix, masanto sk'och heb' ix t'a spat winh rey chi'.
Ach rey, a heb' uninal ol em k'ojan b'aj tz'emtaxon k'ojan heb' a mam icham. Ol ak'anoch yopisio heb' yik syilan masanil yol a makb'en tik heb'.
Ha in ol wak' nachajkot a b'i yuj masanil anima toto ol aljok t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ol yal wach' lolonel junjun chonhab' t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
